name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell at each shoulder with palms facing each other.
Brace your core and align your elbows directly beneath the handles.
Press both dumbbells straight overhead without turning your palms until your arms extend.
Lower the dumbbells under control back to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your ribs down instead of arching your lower back as your arms straighten.
Keep your knees quiet rather than using leg drive to push the dumbbells overhead.
